answer.rationale: Verify the archived renewal negotiation record to confirm the incumbent can move materially on price and payment terms. Negotiate against market benchmarks, seek an 18% total-cost reduction, and use the expiring contract and committed volume as leverage while preserving supply continuity. Switching vendors could reduce unit cost but would increase delivery and integration risk with the line already at 94% of committed volume; a second source would address resilience but is less likely to meet the immediate spend mandate. Multi-year pricing may provide additional leverage, but should be accepted only if service scope and delivery protections remain intact.
